H0256G.name: Ahab
H0256G.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0256G.brief: Wicked king of Israel; husband of Jezebel
H0256G.short: Ahab, son of Omri, reigned as king of Israel and did evil in the sight of the Lord.

H0256H.name: Ahab
H0256H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0256H.brief: False prophet during the Babylonian exile
H0256H.short: Ahab, son of Kolaiah, was a false prophet among the exiles in Babylon.

H0271H.name: Ahaz
H0271H.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H0271H.short: Ahaz was a descendant of Saul and Jonathan, from the tribe of Benjamin.

H0271G.name: Ahaz
H0271G.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0271G.brief: King of Judah, son of Jotham
H0271G.short: Ahaz, son of Jotham, reigned as king of Judah for 16 years.

H0274G.name: Ahaziah
H0274G.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0274G.brief: King of Israel, son of Ahab
H0274G.short: Ahaziah, son of Ahab, reigned as king of Israel for two years.

H0274H.name: Ahaziah
H0274H.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0274H.brief: King of Judah, son of Jehoram and Athaliah
H0274H.short: Ahaziah (also called Jehoahaz), son of Jehoram, reigned as king of Judah for one year.

H0257.name: Ahban
H0257.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0257.brief: Son of Abishur, from the tribe of Judah
H0257.short: Ahban was the son of Abishur, a descendant of Judah.

H0277G.name: Ahi
H0277G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0277G.brief: Son of Abdiel, a Gadite chief
H0277G.short: Ahi, son of Abdiel, was a chief of the Gadites.

H0277H.name: Ahi
H0277H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0277H.brief: Son of Shomer, from the tribe of Asher
H0277H.short: Ahi (or "brother") was a son of Shomer (or 'Shamer'), a descendant of Asher.

H0281N.name: Ahiah
H0281N.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0281N.brief: Priest who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
H0281N.short: Ahiah was a priest who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

H0279.name: Ahiam
H0279.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H0279.brief: One of David's mighty men, son of Sharar
H0279.short: Ahiam, son of Sharar the Hararite, was one of David's mighty men.

H0291.name: Ahian
H0291.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0291.brief: Son of Shemidah, from the tribe of Manasseh
H0291.short: Ahian was a son of Shemidah, a descendant of Manasseh.

H0295H.name: Ahiezer
H0295H.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0295H.brief: Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
H0295H.short: Ahiezer was a Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.

H0295G.name: Ahiezer
H0295G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0295G.brief: Leader from the tribe of Dan during the Exodus
H0295G.short: Ahiezer, son of Ammishaddai, was a leader of the tribe of Dan during the Exodus.

H0284.name: Ahihud
H0284.brief: Son of Ehud, from the tribe of Benjamin
H0284.short: Ahihud was a son of Ehud, a descendant of Benjamin.

H0282.name: Ahihud
H0282.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0282.brief: Leader from the tribe of Asher for land allocation
H0282.short: Ahihud, son of Shelomi, was a leader from the tribe of Asher appointed to help allocate the Promised Land.

H0281L.name: Ahijah
H0281L.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0281L.brief: One of David's mighty men, the Pelonite
H0281L.short: Ahijah the Pelonite was one of David's mighty men.

H0281J.name: Ahijah
H0281J.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H0281J.brief: Son of Jerahmeel, from the tribe of Judah
H0281J.short: Ahijah was a son of Jerahmeel, a descendant of Judah.

H0281M.name: Ahijah
H0281M.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0281M.brief: Levite in charge of the treasuries of the temple
H0281M.short: Ahijah, a Levite, was in charge of the treasuries of the house of God.

H0281K.name: Ahijah
H0281K.brief: Son of Ehud, from the tribe of Benjamin
H0281K.short: Ahijah was a son of Ehud, a descendant of Benjamin.

H0281H.name: Ahijah
H0281H.desc: Prophet living at the time of United Monarchy
H0281H.brief: Prophet from Shiloh who prophesied to Jeroboam
H0281H.short: Ahijah the Shilonite was a prophet who foretold Jeroboam's rise to power and the division of the kingdom.

H0281I.name: Ahijah
H0281I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0281I.brief: Father of Baasha, king of Israel
H0281I.short: Ahijah was the father of Baasha, who became king of Israel and ruled for 24 years.

H0281G.name: Ahijah
H0281G.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H0281G.brief: Son of Seraiah (or 'Shisha'), a scribe during Solomon's reign
H0281G.short: Ahijah, son of Seraiah (or 'Shisha'), served as a scribe during King Solomon's reign.

H0296.name: Ahikam
H0296.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0296.brief: Son of Shaphan, protected Jeremiah from death
H0296.short: Ahikam, son of Shaphan, was an official during the reigns of Josiah and Jehoiakim, and he protected Jeremiah from death.

H0286.name: Ahilud
H0286.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H0286.brief: Father of Jehoshaphat and Baana, officials under David and Solomon
H0286.short: Ahilud was the father of Jehoshaphat, David's recorder, and Baana, one of Solomon's twelve district governors.

H0290I.name: Ahimaaz
H0290I.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H0290I.short: Ahimaaz, who was married to Solomon's daughter Basemath, served as the governor of Naphtali during Solomon's reign.

H0290G.name: Ahimaaz
H0290G.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H0290G.short: Ahimaaz was the father of Ahinoam, who was the wife of King Saul.

H0290H.name: Ahimaaz
H0290H.desc: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
H0290H.brief: Son of Zadok the priest, a messenger for David
H0290H.short: Ahimaaz, the son of Zadok, was a messenger who helped David during Absalom's rebellion and brought news of Absalom's death.

H0289H.name: Ahiman
H0289H.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H0289H.short: Ahiman was a Levite who served as a gatekeeper during the reign of David.

H0289G.name: Ahiman
H0289G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0289G.brief: One of the giant descendants of Anak in Hebron
H0289G.short: Ahiman was one of the three giant descendants of Anak who lived in Hebron and were driven out by Caleb.

H0288G.name: Ahimelech
H0288G.desc: High Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
H0288G.brief: High Priest at Nob who helped David, killed by Saul
H0288G.short: Ahimelech, the High Priest at Nob, gave David consecrated bread and Goliath's sword but was later killed by Saul for aiding David.
H0288G.meaning: “my brother is king” or “brother of Melek”

forms.meaning: “my brother is king” or “brother of Melek”

H0288H.name: Ahimelech
H0288H.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H0288H.brief: Son of Ahitub, a Hittite warrior who joined David
H0288H.short: Ahimelech the Hittite was one of David's warriors who accompanied him to Saul's camp while Saul was pursuing David.
H0288H.meaning: “my brother is king” or “brother of Melek”

forms.meaning: “my brother is king” or “brother of Melek”

H0288I.name: Ahimelech
H0288I.desc: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
H0288I.brief: Son of Abiathar, a priest during David's reign
H0288I.short: Ahimelech, son of Abiathar, served as a priest during the reign of King David.
H0288I.meaning: “my brother is king” or “brother of Melek”

forms.meaning: “my brother is king” or “brother of Melek”
“Melek is father” or “my father is king”

H0287.name: Ahimoth
H0287.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0287.brief: Levite descendant of Kohath, son of Elkanah
H0287.short: Ahimoth, also known as Mahath, was a Levite descended from Kohath, the son of Elkanah.
H0287.meaning: “brother of death” or “my brother is death”

forms.meaning: “brother of death” or “my brother is death”

H0292.name: Ahinadab
H0292.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H0292.brief: Son of Iddo, a governor under Solomon
H0292.short: Ahinadab, the son of Iddo, was one of Solomon's twelve governors, responsible for providing provisions for the king's household.

H0293G.name: Ahinoam
H0293G.desc: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
H0293G.brief: Wife of King Saul, daughter of Ahimaaz
H0293G.short: Ahinoam, the daughter of Ahimaaz, was one of King Saul's wives.

H0293H.name: Ahinoam
H0293H.desc: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
H0293H.brief: Wife of David, from Jezreel; mother of Amnon
H0293H.short: Ahinoam of Jezreel was one of David's wives and the mother of his firstborn son, Amnon.

H0283H.name: Ahio
H0283H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0283H.short: Ahio was a son of Elpaal and a descendant of Benjamin.

H0283I.name: Ahio
H0283I.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H0283I.short: Ahio was a son of Abiel (or 'Jeiel'), a Benjamite who was the re-founder of Gibeon.

H0283G.name: Ahio
H0283G.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H0283G.brief: Son of Abinadab, accompanied the ark from Kiriath-jearim
H0283G.short: Ahio, along with his brother Uzzah, drove the cart carrying the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim.

H0299.name: Ahira
H0299.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0299.brief: Leader of the tribe of Naphtali during the Exodus
H0299.short: Ahira, son of Enan, was the leader of the tribe of Naphtali during the Israelites' journey through the wilderness.

H0297.name: Ahiram
H0297.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0297.brief: Son of Benjamin, founder of the Ahiramite clan
H0297.short: Ahiram, also known as Aharah or Ehi, was a son of Benjamin and the founder of the Ahiramite clan.
H0297.meaning: “my brother is exalted” or “brother or (the) lofty”

forms.meaning: “my brother is exalted” or “brother or (the) lofty”

H0294.name: Ahisamach
H0294.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0294.brief: Father of Oholiab, a skilled artisan for the tabernacle
H0294.short: Ahisamach, from the tribe of Dan, was the father of Oholiab, a skilled artisan who helped construct the tabernacle.

H0285I.name: Ahitub
H0285I.desc: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0285I.brief: Ancestor of Ezra the scribe, in the priestly line
H0285I.short: Ahitub, son of Amariah and father of Zadok, was an ancestor of Ezra the scribe in the priestly line.

H0285G.name: Ahitub
H0285G.desc: High Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
H0285G.brief: Father of Ahimelech, High Priest at Nob killed by Saul
H0285G.short: Ahitub was the father of Ahimelech, the High Priest at Nob who was killed by Saul for aiding David.

H0285H.name: Ahitub
H0285H.desc: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
H0285H.brief: Father of Zadok the priest during David's reign
H0285H.short: Ahitub was the father of Zadok, who served as a priest alongside Abiathar during the reign of King David.

H0265.name: Ahoah
H0265.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0265.brief: Descendant of Benjamin, clan of David's mighty men
H0265.short: The Ahohites, descendants of Ahoah of Benjamin, were a clan that included some of David's mighty men, such as Eleazar and Zalmon.

H0267.name: Ahumai
H0267.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0267.short: Ahumai was a descendant of Judah through his grandson Reaiah.

H0275.name: Ahuzzam
H0275.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0275.brief: Son of Ashhur and Naarah, a Judahite
H0275.short: Ahuzzam was the son of Ashhur and his wife Naarah, from the tribe of Judah.

H0276.name: Ahuzzath
H0276.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0276.brief: Friend and advisor of Abimelech, Philistine king of Gerar
H0276.short: Ahuzzath was a friend and advisor of Abimelech, the Philistine king of Gerar, who accompanied him when making a treaty with Isaac.

H0245.name: Azaniah
H0245.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0245.brief: One of the Levites who sealed the covenant
H0245.short: Azaniah was one of the Levites who sealed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah (<ref="Neh.10.9">Neh.10.9</ref>).

H0229.name: Ezbai
H0229.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0229.brief: Father of Naarai, one of David's mighty men.
H0229.short: Ezbai was the father of Naarai, who was one of David's mighty men.

H0201.name: Omar
H0201.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0201.brief: Son of Eliphaz, grandson of Esau
H0201.short: Omar was a son of Eliphaz and a grandson of Esau, mentioned in the genealogies of Edom.

H0203.name: On
H0203.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0203.short: On was a Reubenite who joined Korah in his rebellion against Moses and Aaron.

H0208H.name: Onam
H0208H.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H0208H.brief: Descendant of Judah, son of Jerahmeel
H0208H.short: Onam was a descendant of Judah, the son of Jerahmeel, and had two sons, Shammai and Jada.

H0208G.name: Onam
H0208G.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0208G.short: Onam was a descendant of Seir the Horite, mentioned in the genealogies of Edom.

H0209.name: Onan
H0209.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0209.short: Onan was the second son of Judah, who was punished by God for his wicked actions.

H0211G.name: Ophir
H0211G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0211G.short: Ophir was a son of Joktan, a descendant of Shem, mentioned in the Table of Nations.

H0218A.name: Ur
H0218A.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0218A.brief: Father of one of David's mighty men
H0218A.short: Ur was the father of Eliphal, one of David's mighty men.

H0221H.name: Uri
H0221H.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H0221H.brief: Father of Geber, one of Solomon's officers
H0221H.short: Uri was the father of Geber, one of the twelve officers appointed by Solomon to provide for the king and his household.

H0221G.name: Uri
H0221G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0221G.brief: Father of Bezalel, the skilled craftsman
H0221G.short: Uri was the father of Bezalel, the skilled craftsman chosen by God to construct the tabernacle and its furnishings.

H0221I.name: Uri
H0221I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0221I.brief: Postexilic Israelite who agreed to put away his foreign wife
H0221I.short: Uri was one of the postexilic Israelites who agreed to put away his foreign wife during the time of Ezra's reforms.

H0223G.name: Uriah
H0223G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0223G.brief: Priest during the reign of King Ahaz
H0223G.short: Uriah was a priest during the reign of King Ahaz who followed the king's instructions in building a new altar based on a pagan model from Damascus.

H0223A.name: Uriah
H0223A.desc: Bathsheba's husband living at the time of United Monarchy
H0223A.short: Uriah was a Hittite soldier in David's army, the husband of Bathsheba, who was killed in battle as part of David's plan to cover up his adultery with Bathsheba.

H0223H.name: Uriah
H0223H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0223H.brief: Postexilic priest involved in rebuilding the wall
H0223H.short: Uriah was a postexilic priest who participated in rebuilding the wall of Jerusalem and was entrusted with the temple treasures.

H0223B.name: Uriah
H0223B.desc: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0223B.brief: Prophet from Kiriath-jearim who prophesied against Jerusalem
H0223B.short: Uriah was a prophet from Kiriath-jearim who prophesied against Jerusalem and Judah during the reign of King Jehoiakim, and was killed for his message.

H0223I.name: Uriah
H0223I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0223I.brief: Priest who assisted Ezra in reading the Law
H0223I.short: Uriah was one of the priests who assisted Ezra in reading the Law to the people during the religious revival in Jerusalem.

H0222H.name: Uriel
H0222H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0222H.brief: Kohathite leader who helped bring the ark to Jerusalem
H0222H.short: Uriel, a Kohathite leader, assisted in bringing the ark to Jerusalem.

H0222G.name: Uriel
H0222G.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0222G.brief: Kohathite Levite, ancestor of the prophet Samuel
H0222G.short: Uriel, also known as Zephaniah, was a Kohathite Levite and an ancestor of the prophet Samuel.

H0222I.name: Uriel
H0222I.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H0222I.brief: Father of mother of Abijah, king of Judah
H0222I.short: Uriel was the father of the mother of Abijah, king of Judah.

H0206G.name: Aven Valley
H0206G.brief: Plain near Damascus, prophesied to be destroyed.
H0206G.short: Aven Valley, a plain near Damascus, was prophesied to be destroyed. (<ref="Amo.1.5">Amo.1.5</ref>)

H0243.name: Aznoth-tabor
H0243.brief: Border town of Naphtali near Mount Tabor.
H0243.short: Aznoth-tabor was a border town of Naphtali near Mount Tabor. (<ref="Joshua 19:34">Joshua 19:34</ref>)

H0237.name: Ezel Stone
H0237.brief: Location where David and Jonathan planned to meet
H0237.short: The Stone of Ezel, a location where David and Jonathan planned to meet and communicate secretly during David's flight from King Saul.

H0204.name: On
H0204.brief: An ancient Egyptian city, mentioned in relation to Joseph
H0204.short: On, also known as Heliopolis, was an ancient Egyptian city mentioned in the Bible in connection with Joseph's life and prophetic references to Egypt.

H0207.name: Ono
H0207.brief: A town in Benjamin, near Lod
H0207.short: Ono was a town in the territory of Benjamin, often mentioned together with Lod, and was the site of a proposed meeting between Nehemiah and his enemies.

H0211H.name: Ophir
H0211H.brief: A region known for its gold
H0211H.short: Ophir was a region famous for its high-quality gold, which was imported to Israel during the reigns of David and Solomon.

H0210.name: Uphaz
H0210.brief: A place known for its fine gold
H0210.short: Uphaz, a place mentioned in the Bible, known for its high-quality gold (<ref="Jer. 10:9; Dan. 10:5">Jer. 10:9; Dan. 10:5</ref>).

H0218B.name: Ur
H0218B.brief: The hometown of Abraham in Mesopotamia
H0218B.short: Ur of the Chaldeans, the hometown of Abraham in Mesopotamia, from where God called him to go to the land of Canaan (<ref="Gen. 11:28, 31; 15:7; Neh. 9:7">Gen. 11:28, 31; 15:7; Neh. 9:7</ref>).

H0242.name: Uzzen-sheerah
H0242.brief: A town built by Sheerah, daughter of Ephraim
H0242.short: Uzzen-sheerah, a town built by Sheerah, the daughter of Ephraim, along with the towns of Upper and Lower Beth-horon (<ref="1Chr. 7:24">1Chr. 7:24</ref>).

H0224.name: Urim
H0224.brief: Objects used with the Thummim for divine guidance
H0224.short: The Urim, along with the Thummim, were objects carried in the breastpiece of the high priest's ephod and used to seek divine guidance (<ref="Exodus 28:30; Numbers 27:21">Exodus 28:30; Numbers 27:21</ref>).
